english.note: Use this intensifying construction before an adjective, such as 好多 for “an awful amount.”
Use this construction before another adjective when the result is pleasantly or desirably A, as in 好熱 for “nice and hot.”

examples.english: There was an awful amount of work today.
examples.jyutping: gam1 jat6 jau5 hou2 do1 je5 zou6

examples.english: The soup is nice and hot today.
examples.jyutping: gam1 jat6 di1 tong1 hou2 jit6
